findings.issue: EncodeDecodeRoundtripStatement remains a def Prop quantifying every StructurallyAdmissibleIR ir to decodeBytes (encodeModule ir) = .ok ir. R18 does not prove that proposition. Full P19 acceptance stays false.

decodeBytes_encodeModule_of_lex_and_parse still assumes h_lex and h_parse. Object-decoder success is discharged. Lexical and parser success are not. Compiling the theorem with standard axioms is not a proof of the premises.

Independently replayed exact root diagnostic. Unterminated value/key after whitespace return notJsonObject; R15 returned noncanonicalWhitespace. No-whitespace controls remain notJsonObject. Malformed-input precedence, not an admissible-domain roundtrip counterexample. R19 author has both repairs; not inspected.
Exact six mixed-error controls match R15 bit-for-bit on the private rebuild. Scientific, whitespace, later duplicate, and maxDepth after malformed escape are restored. Two unchanged controls remain.
32 C0 collision positive roundtrips, true duplicate, equivalent escaped duplicate, and quote/backslash positives match R16 bit-for-bit.

Strongest actual general R18 results are enum/base inverses for NumericUnitEnc/UnitEnc/UnaryOpEnc and scalar/first-field parser facts. Child foldlM success remains assumed in first-field support facts. These do not close arbitrary recursive Expr/list/object/envelope inversion.

Nested object/array step facts still take child foldlM success (h_val/h_feed) or tokenizer/parser success (h_tok/h_parse). New first-field facts do the same. Exact remaining obligation is recursive object/array/ExprEnc.unary|binary|ite/list/envelope tokenization and parseTokens inversion from StructurallyAdmissibleIR.

Concrete new concern: remaining unterminated-whitespace defect is checker-visible as codec malformed notJsonObject, not as blocked and not as kernel execution. Size 1048577 still resourceLimit maxBytes / codec blocked. Size 1048576 is not rejected by the exclusive-greater size gate. C0 valid-domain roundtrips still succeed. Do not treat the unterminated cases as SupportedIR counterexamples. Domain 1MiB/depth64/array4096/full canonical strings remain.

Independent #print axioms of exact 311 named declarations on the private rebuild succeeded. Includes lemma exprDepth_pos. 299 standard, 12 none, 0 forbidden. Name/axiom map equals author CMD-07. Not whole-P19 acceptance.

Actual author Verify reports Certificates 1498/2545, Typed 420/677, Composition 287/408; those historical author execution scopes are separate from the 311 named probe. 7/21 and 54/99/16 were not re-run.

All 299 previous R17 named declarations are present. CanonicalJson 62→68 (+6). Correspondence 237 named remain plus +6 theorems give 243 named. exprDepth_pos predates R17. R17 added 29 theorems; R18 adds 12.
